items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: see Chu, Noah and myself had got the paper

ctx.x: Oh boy, he could swing, that's the thing, see just anything. Tell you what we did. We were working the Palomar Theatre in Seattle, Washington, with Cab. And

this woman came by, she owned this club, and wanted if Chu and I could come on out there and play. You know, jam, which is all right, we didn't think too much of jamming in those days. We didn't care too much, didn't care. So anyway we went out that night, you know, after you'd finished, I thought it was nice little band, we loved to sit in with the band, because they could play, you know, we got to know the boys. So, everything went well and we told the woman we'll be back Saturday, or whatever night it was.…
